Public build headers and import definitions for the asset-free Windows runtime cross-build.
Original copyright notices and licenses are preserved. SDL/FFmpeg/shaderc inputs match the externally verified prior build cache; Vulkan/VMA match its existing header snapshots.
No runtime DLLs, compiled import libraries, compiler executables, fonts, game files or generated game code are included. The CI build regenerates import libraries with the pinned public LLVM-MinGW toolchain.
See PROVENANCE.json and FILES-SHA256.json.
